scope: COV-018s: nominal degree particle 깨나, plural bases, and preservation of spelling/lexical homonyms.
source_attribution: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, September 2026 export; all senses and notes, up to two example groups.

examples: 이렇게 더운 날씨에 운동을 했으니 민준이도 땀깨나 흘렸겠다.
수학깨나 한다고 자부했던 승규에게도 이번 수학 시험은 너무 어려웠다.

additional_sources.finding: NIKL distinguishes nominal degree 깨나 from adverb 꽤 + particle 나; 심술깨나 is an example.
NIKL accepts 아씨들깨나 in its answer dated 2025-06-10. The plural suffix remains a separate component.

annotated_fixture.interpretation: This test-split example was inspected to develop the fix and is now an exposed regression case, not held-out evaluation.

dictionary_gaps.effect: Raw recovery is required. The full KRDict snapshot has no 아씨 entry; both dictionary filters remove this path. Offline and browser regressions retain this distinction.

remaining: Source examples establish nominal degree usage, not a lexical semantic quantifiability classifier or contextual sense selector.

Existing nominalization, outer-particle and particle-marked copula machinery can expose additional hypotheses. Their semantic felicity and wider particle combinations remain unjudged; there is no new predicate/adverbial or preceding-case license.
Raw additions include 따다/땋다 + 음 + 깨나 for 땀깨나, and 어 + 깨나 for 어깨나 alongside the preserved 어깨 + 나 reading. These are not all precision gains.
Whole unknown nominal strings, including apparent repeated/case-marked surfaces, remain candidates. Forbidden judgments exclude only their explicitly segmented paths.
Independent Korean-language review and the remaining inventory/checklist families remain open.

inputs: All current main validity ledger surfaces
쀍깨나, ABC깨나, 2026깨나, and 64 repeated 가 syllables
